title: Proceedings governed by other law.
bodyText: This chapter does not govern an adoption proceeding or a proceeding pertaining to the authorization of emergency medical care for a child.
bodyHtml: [§583A-103]  Proceedings governed by other law.  This chapter does not govern an adoption proceeding or a proceeding pertaining to the authorization of emergency medical care for a child. [L 2002, c 124, pt of §2]
